reviewFlags.issue: The catalog gives 819 L net, 492 L fridge and 327 L freezer. Both Israeli retailer pages give 852 L total, 510 L fridge and 342 L freezer. The published capacity rows follow the retailers, so check the capacity against the manufacturer before relying on it.
The catalog says נירוסטה. bug.co.il says כסוף and soferavi.co.il says פלטינום סטיל מוברש. The published colour is the soferavi wording.
soferavi.co.il gives depth 87 ס״מ and width 91 ס״מ. bug.co.il gives depth 86.1 ס״מ and width 91.2 ס״מ. A person should confirm the exact dimensions for a niche installation.
soferavi.co.il says the compressor warranty is 10 years and bug.co.il says 20 years. The compressor warranty is not published.
No manufacturer or Samsung Israel page for this model was reachable. The samsung.com/il support URL returned 404. The warranty and importer facts rest on two Israeli retailer pages.
bug.co.il describes the ice makers as large cubes and diamond cubes. soferavi.co.il describes cubes and whiskey balls. The published feature uses the bug.co.il wording.
Catalog gives 819 L net / 492 L fridge / 327 L freezer; retailers give 852 / 510 / 342 L (apparently gross). Confirm which figures to present.
soferavi.co.il gives 87 cm depth and 91 cm width; bug.co.il reportedly gives 86.1 cm and 91.2 cm. Confirm for niche installation.
Catalog says נירוסטה; retailer says פלטינום סטיל מוברש.
No manufacturer page was available; all facts rest on Israeli retailer pages.
